class_name: 割合-割合-ニタイシテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Sets one quantity beside a stated reference quantity so the two can be weighed, and the comment that follows is usually an evaluation of the balance (収入に対して家賃が高い, 水の量に対して米が多い). Its sibling entry marks the target of an action or feeling (子供に対して, 抗議する), and clause-level contrast uses のに対して (男性が78歳であるのに対して). につき is the usual choice when a fixed rate is charged or allotted per unit (一人につき千円).

examples.ruby: 定員[ていいん]三十名[さんじゅうめい]に対[たい]して応募[おうぼ]が百件[ひゃっけん]あった。
examples.english: There were a hundred applications for only thirty places.

examples.ruby: 収入[しゅうにゅう]に対[たい]して家賃[やちん]の負担[ふたん]が大[おお]きすぎる。
examples.english: The rent takes far too big a bite out of my income.

examples.ruby: 水[みず]の量[りょう]に対[たい]して米[こめ]が多[おお]すぎたらしい。
examples.english: It seems there was too much rice for the amount of water.

patterns.usage_note: States a rate: a counted unit takes について or につき and the same amount goes to every such unit (一人について五百円, 一回につき二錠). The sibling lane of this string names a topic, what is talked or written about (歴史について調べる). につき is the realization normally met in this sense, and the same string is also a stiff 'owing to' in notices and formal letters (本日休業につき).

examples.ruby: 入場料[にゅうじょうりょう]は一人[ひとり]について五百円[ごひゃくえん]いただきます。
examples.english: We charge five hundred yen per person for admission.

examples.ruby: この薬[くすり]は一回[いっかい]につき二錠[にじょう]飲[の]んでください。
examples.english: Take two tablets of this medicine each time.

examples.ruby: 一世帯[いっせたい]につき二台[にだい]まで駐車[ちゅうしゃ]できます。
examples.english: Each household may park up to two vehicles.
